command_center.decision_question: Which AI/technology bets deserve more capital, which need evidence, which are blocked, and which should stop?
command_center.executive_summary: Modeled technology spend is $650.0M, about 75% run/operate. AI-tagged spend is $53.7M against $777.5M promised value, of which finance has partially validated $189.5M. Across funded bets the decision posture is 18 fund, 1 fix, 7 freeze. Realized value stays blocked until usage, KPI movement, and finance validation line up.

value_funnel.caveat: Non-additive lens on the funded base.
Realized value is not claimable until validation completes.
